name: formdesign
description: Make and edit page layouts in FormDesign in plain language: magazines, newsletters, reports, flyers, posters, ads, web pages and decks from your files and a brief, exported as PDF, IDML, HTML, EPUB or images.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to FormDesign running on this computer. Start FormDesign first (the desktop app, or ./formdesign boot); this extension never starts it. Until FormDesign answers, only a ping tool is offered, and the full tool list appears once it does. Window > Agent Connect in FormDesign decides what outside agents may do.

engine_url.title: FormDesign engine address
engine_url.description: Where the FormDesign engine listens. The default suits a FormDesign started on this computer.
